cases.name: Joyce Ann Engelbrecht
cases.about: Fellow church member Rachel Schoenecker said Joyce “volunteered to do anything and everything. She said Joyce was a caring and generous woman who hosted a baby shower for her and once quietly gave her money unsolicited when she was a struggling new mom. Schonecker used the money to buy formula for her baby.
cases.narrative: Shot in forehead with .22 caliber rifle.

cases.name: Rachel Elaine Schulz Linder
cases.about: Her obituary said Rachel had worked as a paramedic, CNA and TNA at Pleasant View Good Samaritan Society, and a paraprofessional at Winfair Elementary in Windom. She loved to vacation and ride motorcycle, play darts, her pets and spend time with her kids, family and friends.
